definitions.gloss: urgent task; pressing matter; top priority
definitions.explanation: Something that needs to be addressed immediately. A formal word commonly used in news, politics, and business to describe issues requiring immediate action.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急務|きゅうむ}だ。
examples.english: Securing personnel is an urgent task.

examples.japanese: ⟦{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}→老朽化：07646_roukyuuka⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦インフラ→インフラ：09898_infura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{整備|せいび}→整備：04037_seibi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急務|きゅうむ}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Maintenance of aging infrastructure is a pressing matter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少子化|しょうしか}→少子化：04807_shoushika⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧{急務|きゅうむ}な⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Measures against the declining birthrate are one of the most pressing issues for the country.

notes:
A formal noun meaning an urgent task or matter requiring immediate attention. Very commonly used in news reports, government statements, and business contexts. Almost always appears in the pattern ～⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急務|きゅうむ}だ (... is an urgent matter).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急務|きゅうむ}だ: ... is an urgent task
- ～⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急務|きゅうむ}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧: ... is a pressing matter (formal)
- ～⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急務|きゅうむ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧: ... is considered urgent
- ⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧{急務|きゅうむ}な⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧: the most pressing issue

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{喫緊|きっきん}→喫緊：12062_kikkin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{急務|きゅうむ}: an extremely pressing matter
- ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急務|きゅうむ}: countermeasures are urgently needed
- ⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急務|きゅうむ}: reform is urgently needed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧: emergency, urgent — broader; can describe situations, not just tasks
- ⟦{喫緊|きっきん}→喫緊：12062_kikkin⟧: imminent urgency — even more formal; often paired with {急務|きゅうむ}
